system.description: As Suggestion but with no saving throw; the target complies as best it can unless it spends 1 Resolve (plus 1 per raise) to refuse. Only one Demand from the same caster per target every 24 hours.
system.effect: As Suggestion but with no saving throw; the target complies as best it can unless it spends 1 Resolve (plus 1 per raise) to refuse. Only one Demand from the same caster per target every 24 hours.
system.perRaise: Each caster raise adds 1 to the Resolve the target must spend to refuse.
